option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific type of paraganglioma (SDH-deficient) with multiple and recurrent paragangliomas, which encompasses the metastatic paraganglioma to prostate and adrenal bed described in the leaf. The leaf is a specific instance of the broader description in the option.
Hereditary paraganglioma–pheochromocytoma syndrome (SDHB mutation) is the underlying genetic cause (etiology) for the development of metastatic paraganglioma to the prostate and adrenal bed.

Malignant paraganglioma (metastatic or multifocal) is a broader category that includes metastatic paraganglioma to prostate and adrenal bed. The leaf describes a specific presentation of malignant paraganglioma.

Paraganglioma (SDHB-related) is a general diagnosis that encompasses metastatic paraganglioma to prostate and adrenal bed, especially given the SDHB mutation identified in the vignette. The leaf is a more specific description of the disease.
